content.comment_body: I've been working on a small program in [product_name] [version_no], and I've reached the end of the page. I can't add any more lines to my program, and checking the manual and help didn't provide a solution. Thanks in advance for any suggestions.
Could you share a screenshot of what you're seeing? Which [product_name] is your program for?
There is no error message. When I try to add another line to the program, there is simply no available space on the page. It's for [product_name] [version_no].
Now I see the issue. You need to add more pages. Please check the attached video.
Thank you, the issue is resolved.
(smile) ... Thanks for taking the time to create a helpful video - [user_name] definitely deserves a top rating. [user_name], what are your thoughts?
My English isn't very strong. That's why it's easier for me to make a screen recording.

Don't worry so much about your English, my friend. (smile) Honestly, the video is the best way to demonstrate what needs to be done! Even if the person asking has some language difficulties, the video helps a lot.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a limitation in [product_name] [version_no] when creating a program, as they could not add more lines beyond the current page. The absence of an error message and difficulty finding relevant guidance in manuals or help resources caused confusion. The solution involved expanding the program workspace by adding more pages, which was not intuitive for the user, indicating the software could improve on usability and discoverability of this feature.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects either a clear notification or a straightforward way to continue adding to the program, ideally with the software providing additional space automatically or making the expansion feature easy to find.
